title: GAX-P08 - PubMedQA PQA-L qualification and split/leakage manifest
outcome: Qualify the frozen PubMedQA PQA-L source as the first zero-founder-cost real benchmark entry using deterministic source verification, preregistered role splits, exact and near-duplicate leakage audits, and a sealed final-test boundary.
rationale: P08 cannot authorize real evaluation until at least one required benchmark has immutable source identity, verified rights, frozen role membership, leakage evidence, and contamination disclosures. PubMedQA PQA-L is the first candidate because its source revision and MIT terms are public and its closed yes/no/maybe decision surface maps directly to GAX typed actions.
scope_in: Frozen PubMedQA PQA-L acquisition and Git blob verification
Deterministic conversion to GAXBench yes/no/maybe items
Preregistered validation/calibration/test membership derived before model comparison
Exact split-integrity and near-duplicate text audits
Dataset card and public-benchmark contamination disclosure
Dedicated zero-founder-cost GitHub Actions qualification job
Inventory promotion only after real upstream qualification evidence exists
scope_out: No model selection or threshold tuning
No claim that public PubMedQA is free of model pretraining contamination
No use of LONG_ANSWER, reasoning_required_pred, or reasoning_free_pred as model-visible inputs
acceptance: Source identity is pinned to pubmedqa/pubmedqa commit 1cbae8e92f72f20c8d3747cbb3bf5bc53554d997 and data/ori_pqal.json Git blob 38db7750761c78950ed32303e7545bdaa513390c
The build rejects source bytes whose Git blob SHA-1 does not match the frozen blob
The build validates exactly 1000 labeled PQA-L records and preserves PMID only as non-model-visible source identity
Model-visible content contains QUESTION plus abstract CONTEXTS and optional section labels, but excludes LONG_ANSWER, reasoning predictions, final_decision, PMID, YEAR, and MESHES
Actions are deterministically ordered maybe, no, yes and PubMedQA maybe remains an ordinary task answer rather than GAX abstention or information insufficiency

The role policy reproduces the upstream seed-0 label-stratified 500-CV/500-test split, uses upstream CV fold 0 as calibration, folds 1-9 as validation, uses no PQA-L training role, and keeps the official 500-item test role sealed
Role membership is frozen before any real model comparison and serialized without labels
Existing GAX exact duplicate/source/input/counterfactual audits are run across the converted roles
A preregistered cross-role near-duplicate audit uses normalized 5-token shingles and Jaccard threshold 0.80 without exposing raw text in its report
Any unresolved exact or near-duplicate cross-role finding blocks dataset qualification
The qualification report distinguishes within-GAX leakage from unresolved public-benchmark pretraining contamination risk
Final-test gold labels are not written to qualification manifests or artifacts and test BenchmarkItems carry gold=null during qualification
A dedicated GitHub Actions job downloads only the frozen public source, produces metadata-only qualification artifacts, and fails closed if qualification fails
The real inventory entry moves from pending to qualified only after the dedicated job produces actual split-manifest and leakage-audit digests
Exact-head Linux/Windows Python 3.11/3.12 CI remains required before merge
A guarded implementation merge, successful post-main CI, and separate canonical closeout are required before SG-000014 becomes PROVEN

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000014 files and return to the canonical SG-000013 closeout. No real-model results or final-test performance outputs are introduced by this grain.
